nodes.description: The only curative treatment. It has been performed in children with EBV-driven lymphoproliferation, HLH or lymphoma, including one patient not in complete remission from lymphoma at transplant. Sibling donors must be genotyped: one patient transplanted from an HLA-identical brother who also carried the homozygous variant remained unable to control EBV.

nodes.description: 4-1BB-deficient mice develop normally but have reduced cytokine production and CTL activity.
